text:
Alex: quick heads-up — starting lockstep deploy for api/runtime/console/router in ~15m. planning to traffic-anneal 0->40->100 over 20m.
Morgan: thanks. which versions are we pushing?
Alex: api=v3.12.0 runtime=v2.8.4 console=v1.9.0 router=v4.0.1 (all pinned). release-notes already in /releases/2026-03-21.
Priya: copied. runbook checklist? post-deploy smoke + perf checks?
Alex: yep — smoke on /health and /v1/status, KV eviction sanity, and trace sampling sanity in console. also watch router 5xx and p95 latency.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight: infra health OK, schema migrations: none, pinned variants valid. starting coordinated rollout in 10m. wave_id=lk-2026-03-21-01
Sean: adding early-rollback criteria to runbook: if router 5xx > 0.2% sustained for 5m OR api error rate spike > 0.5% -> immediate freeze and rollback to previous pins.
Emily: +1. also if console frontend errors cause >2% user-visible failures during anneal, pause and revert.
Priya: can we add a quick smoke script? putting this in thread:
```
# smoke.sh
curl -fsS https://api.redwood.example.com/health || exit 1
curl -fsS https://console.redwood.example.com/api/ping || exit 1
# check runtime kv count
ssh runtime-neck-01 "/opt/redwood/bin/kvstat | grep total"
```

Morgan: good. deploy-bot — please emit a preflight report to #eng-sre and tag oncall if anything fails.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] preflight report uploaded -> https://internal.releases/reports/lk-2026-03-21-01 (checks: infra OK, image signatures OK, traffic policies validated) :white_check_mark:
Alex: we'll do 3-minute stagger per service inside the lockstep to reduce blast radius — order: router -> runtime -> api -> console.
Sean: confirm rollback target tags: router=v4.0.0 runtime=v2.8.3 api=v3.11.9 console=v1.8.7
Alex: confirmed. I've added these to the deploy note and pinned them in the orchestrator.
Emily: note on observability — enable trace sampling at 50% during anneal and set alerts: router_5xx_rate (threshold 0.2%), api_error_rate (0.5%), console_frontend_error (2%).
Priya: I'll run the post-deploy evals and report token-level latency and cost delta after 1h.
Morgan: planning doc link?
Alex: https://docs.internal/releases/lockstep-lk-2026-03-21 (contains rollout timeline, rollback steps, contact list).
Sean: oncall is @Sean — I'll be watching router dashboards during rolling windows. if we see small spike under 0.2% but p95 jumps >2x, prefer to freeze and investigate before full rollback.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] beginning step: router -> creating new pods (replicas=40). expected rollout duration 6m.
Alex: starting timer. everyone stand by for the 40% traffic shift checkpoint at +8m.
Emily: small FYI — console feature-flag for new metrics UI is off by default, no immediate user surface change.
Priya: smoke results after router: all green, no 5xx seen. runtime warmers show KV cache hit 94%.
Alex: moving to runtime.
Morgan: runtime deploy completed. running anneal to 40%. watching p50/p95.
Priya: runtime p95 +8% (expected), KV hit steady, no errors.
Sean: router p95 flat, 5xx 0.03%. api errors nominal.
Alex: shifting api to 40%.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] traffic update: 40% routed to new variants.
Priya: post-api smoke: /v1/status OK, sampling traces show warm cache.
Emily: console deploy started. keeping feature flag off.
Alex: console is up, moving to anneal 100% in 10m if no issues.
Sean: slight uptick in API p95 at +12m, +15% but error rate still <0.2%. I'm comfortable continuing but want extra eyes on traces.
Priya: running targeted replay for critical prompt set — comparing top-10 outputs, quality unchanged.
Alex: decision: continue to 100%. if any alert in the next 5m we freeze and run rollback plan.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout complete -> 100% traffic on new variants. wave_id=lk-2026-03-21-01 :party_parrot:
Morgan: congrats. please publish release note summary and update the pinned release doc.
Alex: will do. publishing now.
Priya: post-deploy evals queued, will share token-level cost delta and perf after 1h.
Sean: thanks all. if anyone sees anything odd ping me directly @Sean.
Emily: nice smooth roll. :tada:
Alex: closing thread — archiving runbook steps under the release.
